milestone.title: M1: Toolchain and repository setup
milestone.description: Workstation toolchain, AWS access, repository setup and the Terraform state backend.

issues.title: Create a dedicated WSL distro
body: Ubuntu 24.04 WSL distro used only for this project, so its tools and versions stay separate from other projects.

issues.title: Install and pin the project toolchain
body: Every tool the project uses is installed at a pinned version, with checksums or signatures verified where published. apt-installed tools are held so routine upgrades can't change them.

issues.title: Set up AWS CLI access with aws login
body: CLI access through `aws login`: temporary credentials and MFA at sign-in, no stored access keys. A named profile is set as the default, with region eu-north-1.

issues.title: Configure the GitHub repository
body: Ruleset on `main`: pull requests required, no force pushes or deletions, linear history. Squash merges only, with merged branches deleted automatically.

Milestones and issues are generated from JSON files by a PowerShell script. `.gitignore` and pre-commit hooks for formatting, linting and secret scanning, with Renovate keeping pinned versions current.

issues.title: Decide the README skeleton and write the first README
body: Decide the README's section structure for the whole project and write the first version, with the toolchain table and the sections that apply at this stage.

issues.title: Bootstrap the Terraform state backend
body: S3 bucket for Terraform state, created by a small bootstrap configuration: encrypted, versioned, public access blocked, with native state locking.
An ADR records where the bootstrap keeps its own state, since the bucket can't hold the state of the code that creates it.

issues.title: Create accounts for Splunk, Cribl and Snyk
body: Free accounts needed for later downloads. No trials are started until the milestone that uses them.
